Definition: Jered, the name of an antediluvian, and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Jared is the name of an antediluvian, and of an Israelite. In Genesis 5:15, Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared. The fuller story is told on the Jared profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jared matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
